title: RESP on FORMATTIME (INVREQ RESP2 1 for ABSTIME below zero), ASKTIME NOHANDLE with no ABSTIME, READQ TS LENGTH(LENGTH OF area) (LENGERR truncation), RECEIVE MAP ... ASIS keeps lower case

scenarios.summary: ASKTIME NOHANDLE (no ABSTIME) and ASKTIME ABSTIME; FORMATTIME with RESP / RESP2 on the clock's ABSTIME (NORMAL) and on an ABSTIME of -1 (INVREQ RESP2 1)
READQ TS INTO(12 bytes) LENGTH(LENGTH OF it) of a 20-byte item (LENGERR, truncated) and of a 12-byte item (NORMAL)
SEND MAP, then RECEIVE MAP ... ASIS of mixed-case input on a UCTRAN(YES) terminal: the lower case is not translated
